claim.claim-text: 1. A head worn imaging system, comprising:

a light source (120) configured to generate a light beam; a light guiding optical element (100) having a thickness of between 0.1 and 1.5 mm and comprising an entry portion (192) and an exit portion (198), and a variable focus element configured to adjust a curvature of the light beam by adjusting a focus before the light beam enters the light guiding optical element through the entry portion, wherein the light guiding optical element (100) is configured to propagate at least a portion of the light beam by total internal reflection; and wherein the exit portion (198) of the light guiding optical element (100) is configured to selectively allow light addressing the exit portion (198) to exit the light guiding optical element (100) based on an angle of incidence of the light beam.
2. The system of claim 1, wherein the light guiding optical element (100) allows multiplexing of light having a plurality of radii of curvature through the light guiding optical element.
3. The system of claim 1, wherein the exit portion comprises an out-coupling grating (198) corresponding to a particular depth plane.

4. The system of claim 3, wherein a portion of light beam is selected to exit the light guiding optical element based at least on a thickness of the light guiding optical element or the out-coupling grating.
5. The system of claim 1, wherein a portion of light beam is selected to exit the light guiding optical element based at least on a pattern of the out-coupling grating.
6. The system of claim 1, wherein a portion of light beam is selected to enter the light guiding optical element based at least on an in-coupling grating.
